stops.note: What the game is and how to publish it.
Every tuning value in one place: cash, prices, plots, conveyor, steal, lock, tsunami.
The 40 brainrots, 7 rarities, mutations and the weighted spawn picker.
Builds the island at runtime: sea, belt, plots, signs, volcano, palms, coins.
Spawns brainrots at the portal and walks them along the belt.
Builds each brainrot model from plain parts, with its billboard label.
Buy, sell, income ticks, rebirth, upgrades, base lock — server-authoritative.
Carrying a stolen brainrot home, the 20-second timer and the owner yank-back.
The tsunami: warning banner, sweeping wave, splash + stun.
The single player-state store every module reads through.
The eight base plots and their six slots each.
Entrypoint: remotes, players, and starting every system.
Cash bar, event banner, buttons, upgrades and help panels.
Client bootstrap: waits for the remotes, starts the HUD.
Hand-in program: writes dossier.json from game.rbxl, src/ and screenshots/.
